notes.title: The Feast for Crows has Begun!
notes.content:
[i]A lull of silence passed over this blood-filled land as yet another battle has ended in this ceaseless war. A war that has gone on for so long that most do not remember how it began. The corpses were picked clean by the murder of crows that descended in the aftermath. It is time for them to move onto the next battlefield, as the Feast for Crows has long since begun![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416391/A_Game_Of_Thrones__A_Feast_For_Crows/

A Feast for Crows has now officially launched. Take part in the war for the Iron Throne as it reaches its pinnacle phase. While the Great Houses of Lannister and Baratheon are embroiled in a never-ending fight for King's Landing, the Starks attempt to secure a complete dominion over the North. At the same time, House Arryn manoeuvres itself to prepare its grand entrance into the pit. All will fall against those who stands as High as Honor.

The war has grown, and the battlefield has continued to change. With the release of A Feast for Crows DLC, you will be able to control one of four Houses to decide the outcome in this drastically different scenario. Faster and focused on just a part of Westeros, this game mode also introduces House Arryn, their 7 unique House cards, updated rules and a new victory condition: objective points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/7d91c1a924b30644626d60198c88009a03cd0297.jpg[/img]

Each House comes with its own unique Objective, which they will fight endlessly to achieve. You will also draw Secret Objectives from a pool of 28 cards, requiring you to adjust your tactics in order to gather the points you require to achieve victory. Holding castles and lands might not always be the best move now, and diplomacy is more important than ever… and so is betrayal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/9a80858b13ea00cec6e8e1af7c41ba95bf0cba60.jpg[/img]

Are you and the members of your House ready to see the epitome of the battle for the Iron Throne take place? Then prepare yourselves and purchase A Feast for Crows, available now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416391/A_Game_Of_Thrones__A_Feast_For_Crows/

[h2]Bugfixing[/h2]

In addition to the DLC release, several issues affecting the base game have been resolved. 
[list]
[*] Various online desynchronization issues have been resolved.
[*] Balon Greyjoy's effect cancels card strength adding effect on top of the base strength.
[*] Issue with the supply counting when doing a specific move is now fixed.
[*] Challenge: Leaving Kings Landing doesn't ask you to leave power behind is now fixed.
[*] Edge case when user is given an Order select prompt when selecting areas when they have no more Orders left to place is now fixed.
[*] Tutorial: Opponent Details Screen is not disabled while Player Detail Screen is, this is now fixed.
[*] Wildfire rule is not consistent between languages in Lannister challenge 3, this is now fixed.
[*] Some minor localization issues have been fixed.
[/list]


[i]Stay tuned for more news on A Game of Thrones! [/i]

notes.title: Our Journey: From Launch until now
notes.content:
Greetings citizens of Westeros!

It has been a wild 10 months since the release of A Game of Thrones: The Board Game - Digital Edition. We have released the game, as well as the A Dance with Dragons DLC, and are even working on more content to come! We wanted to take a few moments to thank all of our loyal fans and users who have been helping us to squash bugs, and so much more. I won't name you all here, but you know who you are!

Discover our journey through Westeros to get here:
[list]
[*] October 06 - A Game of Thrones: The Board Game - Digital Edition releases on Steam.
[*] October 13 - Steam Patch: Bug fixes and Live Game enabled by default
[*] October 28 - Steam Patch: Bug fixes and updates
[*] November 23 - Steam Patch: Multiple small bug fixes and changes
[*] January 19 - Steam patch & maintenance
[*] April 07 - Mobile version & A Dance with Dragons DLC Released, alongside a number of bug fixes
[*] June 22 - Patch Release, Steam & mobile: Various bug fixes and large scale server updates
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1075190/discussions/0/5197701062338226591/]July 20[/url] - Patch Release, Steam & mobile: Additional bug fixes, resolving remaining stability issues[/list]
In addition to the above changes, we have made a slew of server-side and client changes that did not require updates. These efforts we hope have made the game more enjoyable for everyone and we want to assure you that we are working on more content for the future!

Be sure to view the patch notes for our latest patch here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1075190/discussions/0/5197701062338226591/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png[/img]

We highly recommend that you join us on our Facebook Page to follow us regarding upcoming content and news so that you might stay as up to date as possible!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/AGoTBGDigital/

Thank you again to everyone who makes this community special by offering us feedback, bug reports and details about your play experience

notes.title: The King's Proclamation: New Features and repairs to the kingdom!
notes.content:
Greetings to the great Houses of Westeros.

The king has descended from his throne and has deemed fit to make a number of changes to his kingdom! Read on to learn all about the changes and new features that have been released.

We are proud to announce that these features and changes should optimize the play for a large number of players; reducing desynchronizations and bugs encountered, as well as helping to handle users who are intentionally holding up a match.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png[/img]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]A new Turn timer feature has been implemented. You can enable this feature when creating your match and it will require each action to be made within a specific duration. This is intended to assist with users going AFK, or attempting to obstruct a match from progressing.
[list][*]This is a timer that is active only in "Live Games" that replaces the old functionality to maintain more active matches. Players have 90 seconds to take an action and 180 seconds in the planning phase. Players that exceed this timer or are offline will have their actions made by an AI. Exceeding this timer twice in a tow will cause a player to be permanently replaced by an AI.[/list]
[*]Live games are now off by default. There is now a pop-up that will explain the "Live-game" feature when you create a match to ensure you set all options correctly.
[/list]

[h1]Desynchronization Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changes and improvements have been implemented to the server to minimize desynchronization complications reported previously.
[*]Users should now see far fewer issues with stability and desynchronization as a result, if not completely eliminated in most cases.[list][*]Do note a small issue with inter-device compatibility is still causing desynchronization. Older device clocks can clash with newer ones, resulting in desynchronization. We are actively working on this and will implement a fix as soon as possible.[/list][/list]

[h1]General Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Robb Stark's card ability will now properly trigger if you are defending.
[*]Power tokens are no longer removed from an area when an opposing force moves into an area with units already in it.
[*]A softlock will no longer occur when leaving a port and directly entering combat.
[*]Track Bidding tie-breaking History entries will now display properly.
[*]Crow Killers will not properly force players to remove knights when they have no footmen.
[*]Mustering Limit warnings will now appear as an info prompt, rather than as a pop-up message.
[*]The Queen of Thorns' ability now works on ports for areas you attack.
[/list]

[h1]A Dance with Dragons Fixes: [/h1]
[list]
[*]Mance Rayder now correctly sets combat strength to 0 when the Wildling Track is at 0.
[*]Stannis Baratheon now correctly removes adjacent Support orders
[*]Melisandre now correctly offers you the choice to use her ability or not.
[/list]

[h1]Multiplayer Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]When you resign a match you will no longer see chat messages from it.
[*]If you are invited to a friend match while not online and later accept, you will now be able to correctly select the house you want to play.
[*]"Your Turn" text from lobbies no longer displays incorrectly inside the match.
[*]"Live Game" was visually disabled on fresh installs when creating lobbies, but was functionally enabled. This has now been fixed.
[*]If a Vassal's city is taken, the player controlling that Vassal can now correctly attack that location in the same turn.
[*]Freidn's game invitations will now properly display in the lobby.
[/list]

[h1]Mobile Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bridges are now correctly visible on the mobile playmat.
[*]Tooltips often appeared under the user's finger. This has been fixed.
[*]UI in front-end menus is no longer hard to read with touch-and-hold input. 
[/list]

[h1]Challenges Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reconnecting to a "Coastal Assault" match no longer prevents the user from completing the match.
[*]The Assemble the Fleet challenge now receives the correct progress when taking control of White Harbor.
[/list]

notes.title: A little bird told me of a new patch!
notes.content:
Greetings fellow members of the seven Great Houses,

We gather here today to discuss the coming of a new patch for Westeros, a guiding light in our objective to bring about a greater life for all those that live within the Seven Kingdoms. Please read on as to discover what awaits you the next time you venture through these lands and wage war for the coveted Iron Throne:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Soft Lock - If an AI gained its seventh castle through battle for a neutral territory, the game would soft lock.
[*]Soft Lock - If a player denied support to an AI attacking neutral territory, the AI will get stuck in a support request loop
[*]Cards: Patchface would not remove the last card in hand correctly
[*]Rules: If a house is moved to last on the Iron Throne track through Doran Martell, their turn can be skipped
[*]Rules: Several rule fixes and clarifications made
[*]Ports: If a port was made uncontrolled due to card effects, ships would not be correctly dealt with
[*]Chat: he first letter of chat messages was frequently missed or dropped
[*]Main Menu: The "Quit Game" prompt would stack if "escape" was hit repeatedly in the main menu
[*]Lobby Matches: Live games would not give a prompt when saving and exiting
[*]UI: Wildling Track details were hidden by influence track bidding
[*]UI: Combat prompts would not progress if you panned away from battle
[*]UI: Battle Prompting would not display in southern areas of the map at two zoom levels
[*]UI: Battle Values would not be visible as Martel when attacking Tyrell from East to West Summer Sea
[/list]
[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Tooltips have been updated
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png[/img]

To everyone who has reported bugs, provided details, given feedback; we want to offer our greatest thanks possible and assure you that our improvements and changes for A Game of Thrones: The Board Game - Digital Edition have not stopped. We are already working on a new patch to address further concerns of the community and will communicate more on this in the future.

[i]Thank you and may the gods you worship bring you favor in battle and triumph in war![/i]
